player_prompt.intro:
O iko na Player {player_id} ena {num_rounds}-round ni IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Ena vuku ni round, vakavatoka e dua na yago e wavoki {min_guess} kei {max_guess}.
Baleta ni oti na veivakavatoka, na target (2/3)x(na kena average ni veivakavatoka yadua),
kei na player e tawana tiko kina na nona vakavatoka e vakaikerekere duadua ki na target e wini na round oqo.
Tukuna mada na nomu vakavatoka ena itukutuku '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na kena ibulibuli e sega ni dodonu; Yalovinaka vakauta na nomu vakasama me [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Na kena iwiliwili e tiko ena maliwa ni {min_guess} kei na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Na Dauqito 0 a tarogi {guess0}; Na Dauqito 1 a tarogi {guess1}. Kua ni ya, na Tikina e: {target}.
message.round_draw: E sega ni dua na macala ena qito oqo.
message.round_win: Na dauqito {winner} e qaqa ena raundi!

outcome.p0_wins: Na Dauqito 0 e qoqa sara na veiikotiko.
outcome.p1_wins: Na Dauqito 1 e qoqa sara na veiikotiko.
outcome.draw: E sega ni dua na macala e yaco ena qito.
